In Euphoria, Fezco became one of the most loved characters, even though his rise wasn’t something anyone fully expected at the start.

Angus Cloud was discovered in a pretty unusual way—he was spotted in Brooklyn by a casting agent while working and hanging out, and at first he even thought the offer was a scam. He had no professional acting experience before landing the role, which makes his performance even more impressive. ￼

What made Fez stand out was how different he felt from typical characters in that world. Even though he’s involved in crime, he’s calm, loyal, and genuinely cares about people like Rue. That mix of toughness and kindness gave the show a kind of emotional balance that a lot of viewers connected with. ￼

Because of how natural and real Cloud felt on screen, Fez quickly became a fan favorite. His role grew over time, especially in later seasons, turning him into one of the emotional anchors of the story. ￼

It’s one of those rare cases where casting someone completely new didn’t just work—it ended up shaping the heart of the show.
